title: 2023 AMC 10A Problem 5
statement: How many digits are in the base-ten representation of \(8^5 \cdot 5^{10} \cdot 15^5?\)

solutions.text: Factor everything into primes. \(8^5 \cdot 5^{10} \cdot 15^5\) \(= 2^{15} \cdot 5^{10} \cdot 3^5 \cdot 5^5\) \(= 2^{15} \cdot 5^{15} \cdot 3^5\) \(= 10^{15} \cdot 243.\) That’s \(243\) followed by \(15\) zeros, so it has \(3 + 15 = 18\) digits. Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Factor each base into primes: \(8 = 2^3\) and \(15 = 3 \cdot 5\)
Combine into \(10^{15} \cdot 3^5,\) which is \(3^5\) followed by \(15\) zeros
